security.title: Password Generator
security.description: Create passwords with operating-system cryptographic randomness and check how difficult they are to guess, all in your browser.
security.analysisDescription: Your input is not sent anywhere.
security.guessHelp: Each additional bit roughly doubles the number of guesses required.
security.crackHelp: Assumes an attacker can try 10 billion guesses per second after a password-hash leak.
security.adviceWeak: Use a longer, unique combination instead of common words, repetition or sequences.
security.adviceMedium: This may be usable, but a longer password without predictable names or dates is safer.

guide.title: Password generator guide
guide.description: Passwords use secure randomness supplied by your operating system and are not sent to a server.

blocks.title: Long and unique
blocks.text: Use a different password of at least 16 characters for each service and keep it in a password manager.

blocks.title: Strength score
blocks.text: The score considers common words, repetition, sequences and estimated guesses. It cannot check breach history or multi-factor authentication.

blocks.title: Estimated cracking time
blocks.text: This comparison assumes a leaked password hash and 10 billion guesses per second. Actual time depends heavily on how a service stores passwords and protects accounts.

faq.q: Is the generated password saved?
faq.a: No. It disappears when you leave this page.

faq.q: Is the estimated cracking time a guarantee?
faq.a: No. It is a comparison estimate. Rate limits, password storage and multi-factor authentication change real attack conditions.

faq.q: Is a copied password safe?
faq.a: Other apps may read the clipboard. After use, copy something else to overwrite it.

formatter.title: JSON, SQL & XML Formatter
formatter.description: Validate syntax and format it with readable indentation or as a single line.

guide.title: Formatter guide
guide.description: Your text is parsed only in a separate worker inside this browser.

blocks.title: Finding errors
blocks.text: JSON and XML report detected error locations. SQL is arranged around its statement structure.

blocks.title: Minifying
blocks.text: Characters and spaces inside quoted strings are preserved; only unnecessary structural whitespace and line breaks are removed.

faq.q: Does this run SQL?
faq.a: No. It formats text without connecting to a database.

faq.q: Does it repair invalid JSON?
faq.a: No. To avoid silently changing data, it reports the error instead.

converter.title: CSV, JSON & HTML Table Converter
converter.description: Convert tabular data between CSV, JSON object arrays and HTML table markup.
converter.workerError: The table converter could not start.
converter.readError: The text file could not be read.
converter.placeholder: Enter CSV with headers, a JSON array or an HTML table.

guide.title: Table conversion guide
guide.description: Files and text are handled in a separate worker inside your browser.

blocks.title: CSV
blocks.text: The first row becomes column names. Quoted cells containing commas or line breaks follow standard CSV quoting rules.

blocks.title: JSON & HTML
blocks.text: All keys in a JSON object array become columns. For HTML tables, the first row becomes the header.

faq.q: Can it handle large CSV files?
faq.a: Processing runs separately within your browser's memory limit. Hundreds of thousands of rows may take time depending on file size and device memory.

faq.q: Are scripts inside HTML executed?
faq.a: No. Only table-cell text is extracted; the input HTML is never inserted into the page or executed.

textTools.title: Text Cleanup & Case Converter

textTools.originalDescription: Pasted text is not sent to an external server.
textTools.actionsDescription: Apply an operation to the result without changing the original.
textTools.caseHelp: camelCase capitalizes words after the first; snake_case separates words with underscores; kebab-case uses hyphens; Title Case capitalizes each word.
textTools.koreanDescription: Built-in Korean sentence patterns flag possible issues. Korean depends on context, so review each suggestion before applying it.
textTools.empty: No issues were found by the current rules.

guide.title: Browser text-tools guide
guide.description: Text is handled only in a separate worker in the current tab.

blocks.title: Cleanup
blocks.text: Whitespace and line-break cleanup applies only the selected rules; it does not interpret meaning.

blocks.title: Korean guide
blocks.text: This is a quick helper for frequently mistyped Korean spellings and spacing patterns, not a complete dictionary-based proofreader.

faq.q: Is my document text saved?
faq.a: No. Input is not stored on a server or in browser storage.

faq.q: Should I apply every suggestion?
faq.a: No. Korean has contextual exceptions, so compare each suggestion with the original.

work.title: Korean Workday & Leave Calculator
work.description: Calculate workdays using South Korean weekends and statutory holidays, or estimate statutory leave by hire date or fiscal year.
work.koreanNotice: Uses South Korean holidays and employment rules
work.periodHelp: Includes both the start and end date.
work.extraHelp: Separate company holidays with spaces or commas
work.periodError: The date range could not be calculated.
work.leaveNote: This estimate assumes perfect attendance and at least 80% attendance where required. First-year monthly leave and fiscal-year reconciliation depend on company policy and actual attendance.

guide.title: South Korean workday assumptions
guide.description: Holiday and leave results are estimates for planning.

blocks.title: Public holidays
blocks.text: Includes fixed-date holidays, Lunar New Year, Chuseok, Buddha's Birthday and statutory substitute holidays. Selected confirmed election and temporary holidays are maintained by year; add company closures manually.

blocks.title: Annual leave
blocks.text: Uses the basic structure of South Korea's Labor Standards Act. Actual grants may differ with attendance and a company's fiscal-year policy.

faq.q: Are temporary holidays included automatically?
faq.a: Confirmed dates maintained in the yearly list are included. Add newly announced dates that are not yet listed and company-only closures manually.

faq.q: Is this the same as leave paid on termination?
faq.a: No. Termination settlement should also check leave accrued by hire date and leave already used.

payroll.title: Korean Payroll, Weekly Holiday Pay & Severance Calculator
payroll.description: Estimate payroll in the current browser without sending or storing sensitive salary information.
payroll.koreanNotice: Uses South Korean law, tax rates and Korean won (KRW)

payroll.taxableHelp: Exclude non-taxable allowances such as qualifying meal benefits.

payroll.periodDaysHelp: Enter every calendar day in the period, not only days worked.

guide.title: Korean payroll estimate guide
guide.description: This does not replace an official payslip, filing or statutory settlement.

blocks.title: Take-home pay
blocks.text: Estimates Korean social insurance and monthly income tax from taxable monthly salary and dependents. The employer's reported standard monthly income, non-taxable items and withholding choice may change the result.

blocks.title: Severance
blocks.text: Includes wages in the final three months and 3/12 of annual bonuses and unused-leave pay. Enter all calendar days in the three-month period. Cases where ordinary wage exceeds calculated average wage need separate review.

faq.q: Is the salary I enter saved?
faq.a: No. Every value is calculated only in the current page state and browser memory.

faq.q: Can I use this for a tax filing?
faq.a: No. It is an estimate. Confirm actual withholding and severance with your employer or the relevant South Korean authority.

imagePrivacy.title: Remove Hidden Photo Data (EXIF)
imagePrivacy.description: Inspect and remove GPS location, camera details and capture time that may be stored with a photo.
imagePrivacy.selectHelp: Choose one or more JPG, PNG or WebP photos. Multiple results are bundled as a ZIP.
imagePrivacy.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP photos whose GPS or device details you want to remove
imagePrivacy.compatibility: HEIC and HEIF are not supported. Removing metadata also requires OffscreenCanvas, which is unavailable on iOS 16.3 and earlier. Use iOS 16.4+ or a current Android browser.
imagePrivacy.cleanTitle: A new file was created from the photo pixels only.
imagePrivacy.cleanDescription: The original is unchanged. EXIF, GPS and camera details were removed from the downloaded copy.
imagePrivacy.readError: The photo file could not be read.

guide.title: Privacy check before sharing photos
guide.description: The original and result are handled only in a separate worker in this browser.

blocks.title: What is EXIF?
blocks.text: A camera or phone may store extra data such as device details, date and GPS location inside the photo file, even though it is not visible in the image.

blocks.title: How removal works
blocks.text: Instead of copying the original file structure, the browser redraws only the pixels and saves a new JPG or PNG. Extra data such as EXIF is left behind.

blocks.title: Image quality
blocks.text: JPG is re-encoded, so quality and file size may change slightly. PNG is saved without lossy compression.

faq.q: Does this modify the original photo?
faq.a: No. You download a new copy with hidden data removed.

faq.q: What is metadata?
faq.a: It is information attached to a file in addition to its visible content. This tool inspects EXIF fields including GPS, device and capture time.

faq.q: Is HEIC supported?
faq.a: No. Only JPG and PNG are supported; HEIC and HEIF are not.

guide.title: QR code guide

blocks.title: Center logo
blocks.text: The code uses high error correction and puts white padding behind the logo. A complex logo may reduce recognition in some cameras.

blocks.title: Live camera
blocks.text: After permission is granted on HTTPS, the rear camera is preferred. The camera and analysis worker stop immediately after a QR code is found.

blocks.title: Photo scanning
blocks.text: Large images are reduced to at most 2200px in the browser, and inverted light/dark colors are also tested.

faq.q: Does this check whether a QR URL is safe?
faq.a: No. It displays the QR data but cannot guarantee that a linked site is safe.

faq.q: When is camera permission used?
faq.a: Permission is requested only after you press Scan with camera. Camera tracks stop on success, when turned off, when the tab changes or when you leave the page.

blocks.title: Daylight saving time

blocks.title: Meeting suggestions

faq.q: Does the map contact an external map server?

faq.q: Can I click anywhere to find its time zone?

faq.q: Are public holidays included?

excel.description: Combine Excel files and CSV data into one XLSX in your browser.

modeHelp.vertical: Stack data from every sheet and adjust relative row references in formulas.
modeHelp.horizontal: Place data from every sheet side by side and adjust relative column references in formulas.

files.description: Select XLSX, XLS, XLSB, XLSM or CSV files at once, or add more to the existing list later.
files.hint: XLSX, XLS, XLSB, XLSM or CSV · add more anytime · XLSX output
files.notice: Output is XLSX. Formula and formatting preservation is supported only for XLSX input, and XLSM macros are not preserved.

sheets.title: Sheets to include
sheets.description: Review the sheet names and include only the sheets you need.

mode.label: Merge layout

guide.title: Excel merge guide
guide.description: Understanding input formats and merge layouts helps produce the expected result.

blocks.title: Supported file formats
paragraphs: You can combine XLSX, XLS, XLSB, XLSM and CSV files. The result is always XLSX.
items: XLSX: formulas and common cell formatting can be preserved
XLS, XLSB and XLSM: values and basic sheet structure are converted
CSV: handled as one table of values

blocks.title: Choosing sheets
paragraphs: After adding files, choose all sheets, a shared position rule, or a custom selection for each file.

blocks.title: Choosing a merge layout
paragraphs: Separate sheets keeps each source sheet. Vertical appends rows; horizontal appends columns.
items: Same columns, such as monthly records: vertical
Same rows, such as category records: horizontal

blocks.title: Formulas, formatting and passwords
paragraphs: Formula and formatting preservation applies to XLSX inputs. With values-only disabled, stored results and formulas are retained and relative references are adjusted when rows or columns move. Passwords remain only in browser memory during the task.

blocks.title: Trimming empty areas
paragraphs: Ending trim excludes unused space after content. Consecutive-empty removal scans the completed output and removes middle groups that meet the threshold.
items: Rows and columns can be selected independently
Groups shorter than the threshold remain

blocks.title: Items to verify
paragraphs: XLSM macros, images, external connections, pivots and some advanced objects can be omitted or simplified. Review important output in Excel.

faq.q: Are CSV formulas and styles preserved?
faq.a: No. CSV stores plain values only. The combined result uses XLSX so it can hold richer spreadsheet features.

faq.q: Can XLSB and XLSM files be merged?
faq.a: Yes, but values and basic sheets are converted to XLSX. Formula and formatting preservation is limited to XLSX inputs, and macros are excluded.

faq.q: Can I select the same sheet position from every file?
faq.a: Yes. Enter 2 for every second sheet. Rules such as -3, 3-, 1,3,5 and 2-4 also work.

faq.q: What is the difference between ending trim and middle-empty removal?
faq.a: Ending trim skips blank space after data. Middle-empty removal also scans inside the output for consecutive empty row or column groups.

faq.q: Can encrypted Excel files be merged?
faq.a: Supported Office encryption can be unlocked locally with the password. Damaged files and some older encryption methods may not open.

faq.q: Can a forgotten output password be recovered?
faq.a: No. It is never stored on a server and is cleared from memory after processing, so keep it somewhere safe.

audio.title: Audio Waveform Editor

audio.hint: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC or OGG that your browser can play
audio.compatibility: M4A, AAC and OGG open only when the device and browser support the audio codec inside the file. Long files can use substantial memory because decoded samples and undo history are retained.

guide.title: Audio waveform editing guide
guide.description: Selected audio and edit data remain in the current browser and are not sent to an external server.

blocks.title: Selecting a waveform region
blocks.text: Drag the waveform to create a purple selection. Move it, resize its handles, or enter start and end values with 1ms precision.

blocks.title: Sample-level editing
blocks.text: Mute sets selected samples to zero; Cut and Delete pull later samples forward. Paste inserts the memory clip at the red playback cursor.

blocks.title: Selected-region voice effects
blocks.text: Lower, higher and childlike presets shift pitch while preserving duration; Robot applies fast amplitude modulation. Preview only the selected region before applying it, and a short crossfade softens each boundary.

blocks.title: Keyboard shortcuts
blocks.text: Outside input fields, Space toggles playback. Ctrl+Z or Cmd+Z undoes; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Y redo.

blocks.title: Undo and memory
blocks.text: Decoded PCM samples are retained per channel. History is limited automatically to at most 12 states and roughly 256MB, and is cleared with a new file.

blocks.title: WAV and MP3
blocks.text: WAV creates a compatible 16-bit uncompressed file quickly. MP3 and pitch effects reuse the bundled browser FFmpeg worker during the page session, then terminate it when a new file replaces the current one or the page closes.

blocks.title: Browser file support
blocks.text: Modern browsers normally open MP3 and WAV. M4A, AAC and OGG depend on operating-system and browser codec support.

faq.q: Is audio uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Opening, sample editing, preview and conversion all run in the current browser.

faq.q: Do lower and higher tone presets change gender?
faq.a: No. They do not identify or transform a person's gender; they only alter the selected region's pitch and tone.

faq.q: Where does Paste insert audio?
faq.a: At the current red playback cursor after you click or play through the waveform.

faq.q: Why do long files use so much memory?
faq.a: Compressed audio must be decoded to uncompressed per-channel samples, while preview data and undo states are also retained.

faq.q: Can MP3 export work offline?
faq.a: It may work if the encoder was cached before. On a first visit with no connection, use WAV instead.

faq.q: Does export overwrite the original?
faq.a: No. The original remains unchanged and a new WAV or MP3 is downloaded.

faq.q: Are images sent to a server?
faq.a: No. They are processed only in the current browser.

faq.q: Does this modify my originals?
faq.a: No. Every result is downloaded as a new file.

faq.q: Which formats are supported?
faq.a: Input supports JPG, PNG and WebP, not HEIC or HEIF. Output supports PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF.

faq.q: Can I keep transparency?
faq.a: PNG and WebP keep transparency; JPG turns it white.

faq.q: Why can large images stop?
faq.a: Browsers and devices have canvas and memory limits. Reduce output dimensions or file count.
